Subject: RFP: pilot pricing and production conversion mechanics

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the conversation yesterday — Veridian's procurement team asked me to capture a few concrete items so we can evaluate commercially as part of the RFP. Our primary asks:

1) Pilot pricing: proposed per-token / per-embedding rates for a 3-month pilot at ~1.5M tokens/week average.
2) Conversion mechanics: if we go to production, how do pilot credits convert? Are there lookback credits or guaranteed ceilings?
3) Overage behavior and caps: how are burst overages billed during pilot vs. production; can we cap exposure during pilot?
4) True-up cadence and invoice reconciliation during the first 12 months post-go-live.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with our preferred conversion scenarios (RFP_Pricing_Questions.xlsx). Can you provide a short, numbered response we can attach to the procurement packet?

Anna — thanks for the clear list. Short answers below along with an attached pilot pricing worksheet. I'll follow up with a short note on legal/term implications after internal sync.

1) Pilot pricing (3 month, ~1.5M tokens/week): recommended pilot rate = $0.0009 / token for generation tiers; $0.0025 / 1k embedding units. Pilot is invoiced monthly with a guaranteed floor equal to 50% of the committed pilot volume; unused pilot volume can be credited on conversion (see #2).

2) Conversion mechanics: on conversion to paid production, we provide a lookback credit equal to 70% of unused, invoiced pilot spend (not token count) to be applied against the first 6 months of production invoices. Example: if you pre-billed $30k for pilot and $9k remains unused at conversion, $6.3k (70%) becomes a production credit. Credits are non-refundable and expire after 6 months. If you sign an annual commit within 60 days of pilot end, we increase the lookback credit to 85% (subject to standard SOW/amendment).

3) Overage & cap during pilot: burst overages billed at 1.6x pilot rate up to a hard cap equal to 2x the committed weekly token volume per month. Any consumption beyond the cap triggers an alert and a temporary throttling policy until a purchase order or amendment is in place. Production overage rates and tiers are governed by the signed rate card (we can propose a tiered overage ladder to reduce unit price as volume increases).

4) True-up cadence: monthly true-up with an end-of-year reconciliation and a single invoice adjustment in month 13 if needed. For commits >$250k ARR we can offer quarterly true-ups.

Attachments: Redwood_PilotPricing_v1.xlsx (worked examples + conversion calculator).

Next steps: if this aligns, I'll loop in Marissa (Commercial) and Ben (Finance) to confirm the 85% conversion sweet spot for a 60-day conversion incentive.

Best,

Anna — apologies for the slight delay, we took a short internal approval loop. Below is the consolidated proposal you can attach to the RFP packet. PDF amendment + MAP link attached.

Consolidated proposal (short form):

Pilot pricing
• Pilot term: 3 months (target start: July 12).
• Pilot rates: $0.0009 / generated token; $0.0025 / 1k embedding units.
• Invoicing: monthly based on actual consumption. We will not pre-bill a floor; instead we offer an "invoiced-floor" guarantee equal to 50% of expected pilot consumption per month (applies only to invoiced months).

Conversion credits (lookback)
• If you convert to an annual production commit within 60 days of pilot end, Redwood will apply an 85% credit on unused, invoiced pilot spend toward the first 6 months of production invoices. Example: $30k pilot invoiced, $9k unused at conversion → $7.65k credit applied across months 1–6.
• If conversion occurs after 60 days but within 6 months, the credit is 70% and follows the same application rules. Unused credits expire after 6 months and are non-refundable. Credits cannot exceed invoiced pilot spend (no negative exposure to Redwood).

Overages and burst protection
• Pilot overage rate: 1.6x pilot rate (applied up to the monthly cap).
• Monthly cap: 2x committed weekly token volume (reasonably protects both parties).
• Burst Top-up SKU: customers may pre-purchase Burst Buckets at any time during pilot to avoid throttling. Example SKU: 500k tokens at pilot rate * 1.1. Prepaid Burst Buckets are consumed before overage billing.

True-up and reconciliation
• Monthly true-up; annual reconciliation with a single adjustment in month 13.
• For commits >$250k ARR, quarterly true-ups are available upon request.

Docs & next steps
